headline: Federal Jury Convicts Huawei and Three Subsidiaries
deck: The Justice Department said the three-month trial covered Iran sanctions, bank deception, money laundering and trade-secret theft.
body: A federal jury in the Eastern District of New York returned guilty verdicts after a three-month trial against Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd. and three subsidiaries, the Justice Department said. The department said the case involved U.S. sanctions involving Iran, lying to banks, money laundering and stealing trade secrets from American companies. [E1]

In the same statement, the Justice Department said Huawei and three subsidiaries had conducted business in the United States “on the basis of lies and theft.” UPI also published that statement. [E1][E2]
